lines.zh: 我坐在水晶球上，慢慢飘过去。
lines.en: I sit on my crystal ball and drift along.

lines.zh: 茶壶在托盘上，我推着走。
lines.en: The teapot rides a tray I push along.

lines.zh: 别急，我这把年纪走不快。
lines.en: Don't rush me; at my age I don't walk fast.

lines.zh: 我绕着厅柱转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle halfway around the hall pillar.

lines.zh: 瓷球滚过地砖，没一点声音。
lines.en: The porcelain sphere rolls over tile without a sound.

lines.zh: 我去后堂看看那口锅。
lines.en: I drift to the back room to check the pot.

lines.zh: 从走廊这头到那头，正好一壶茶。
lines.en: End to end of this hall takes one pot of tea.

lines.zh: 我把帘子掀开，慢慢过去。
lines.en: I lift the curtain and pass through slowly.

lines.zh: 我飘到窗边，看看天色。
lines.en: I float to the window to read the sky.

lines.zh: 这屋子太窄，我得侧着走。
lines.en: This room's too narrow; I go sideways.

lines.zh: 我的裙摆扫过香炉，带起一缕烟。
lines.en: My hem brushes the brazier and lifts a thread of smoke.

lines.zh: 我沿着台阶往上，一层一层。
lines.en: I rise along the steps, one tier at a time.

lines.zh: 有人来了，我去门口迎一迎。
lines.en: Someone's here. I'll float to the door.

lines.zh: 水晶球的气流把我推向左边。
lines.en: The sphere's current pushes me to the left.

lines.zh: 我把茶杯转了半圈，又放下。
lines.en: I turn the cup half around and set it down.

lines.zh: 烟雾的形状，我今天看不明白。
lines.en: The smoke's shape won't resolve for me today.

lines.zh: 这球面上有一道旧裂纹。
lines.en: There's an old crack across this sphere.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，也在看。
lines.en: My eyes are shut, and still I'm watching.

lines.zh: 算得太多，头会疼。
lines.en: Too much divining gives me headaches.

lines.zh: 我把手搭在水晶球上，暖的。
lines.en: I rest my hand on the crystal. It's warm.

lines.zh: 外面风大，屋里的烟都歪了。
lines.en: The wind's up; even the smoke leans.

lines.zh: 我数着香灰落下几次。
lines.en: I count how many times the ash falls.

lines.zh: 客人还没来，我先歇一歇。
lines.en: No guest yet. I'll rest a moment.

lines.zh: 这个月的水晶球有点浑。
lines.en: The crystal's gone cloudy this month.

lines.zh: 我把披肩往上拉了拉。
lines.en: I draw my shawl up a little.

lines.zh: 桌上的签筒，我摇了一下。
lines.en: I shake the fortune sticks once.

lines.zh: 我看见你的未来，只是懒得说。
lines.en: I see your future. I just can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 老了啊，腿一坐久就僵。
lines.en: Getting old; sit too long and my legs stiffen.

lines.zh: 来算一卦？先把手伸出来。
lines.en: A reading? Hold out your hand first.

lines.zh: 你的脸上写着两件事，都还没发生。
lines.en: Two things are written on your face. Neither has happened.

lines.zh: 我看见你身后有人跟着。
lines.en: I see someone following behind you.

lines.zh: 钱先放桌上，我不赊账。
lines.en: Coin on the table first. I don't give credit.

lines.zh: 你的命线断过一次，又接上了。
lines.en: Your lifeline broke once and was joined again.

lines.zh: 你从很远的地方来，鞋上都是别人的土。
lines.en: You came far; that's someone else's soil on your boots.

lines.zh: 别以为我看不见你在藏什么。
lines.en: Don't think I can't see what you're hiding.

lines.zh: 你的师父，我认识。
lines.en: Your master — I know him.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，看过太多结局。
lines.en: These eyes have seen too many endings.

lines.zh: 你今晚会做一个梦，记住它。
lines.en: You'll dream tonight. Remember it.

lines.zh: 坐下来吧，站着算不准。
lines.en: Sit. Readings don't work standing up.

lines.zh: 你的气息有点乱，心里有事。
lines.en: Your breathing's uneven. Something weighs on you.

lines.zh: 我不问名字，名字会骗人。
lines.en: I don't ask names. Names lie.

lines.zh: 你身上带了三样东西，只有一样有用。
lines.en: You carry three things. Only one matters.

lines.zh: 别急着问，先喝口茶。
lines.en: Don't ask yet. Have some tea first.

lines.zh: 你想问的那件事，答案很糟。
lines.en: The thing you want to ask — the answer's bad.

lines.zh: 占卜的价钱，比命还贵。
lines.en: A fortune costs more than a life.

lines.zh: 你连算命的都打。
lines.en: You'd strike a fortune teller, too.

lines.zh: 我的披肩滑下来了，扶一下。
lines.en: My shawl slipped. Help me with it.

lines.zh: 水晶球晃了，我抓紧它。
lines.en: The sphere rocks; I hold it tight.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，寿命没短。
lines.en: It hurts, but it hasn't shortened my years.

lines.zh: 我早算到会有这一下。
lines.en: I foresaw this blow.

lines.zh: 血滴在卦纸上，不吉利。
lines.en: Blood on the divination paper. Inauspicious.

lines.zh: 我扶着桌子，喘了口气。
lines.en: I brace on the table and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 年轻人，手劲真大。
lines.en: Young people have such strong arms.

lines.zh: 我没事，只是有点晕。
lines.en: I'm fine. Just a little dizzy.

lines.zh: 钱我收，但话我只说一半。
lines.en: I'll take the coin, but I only tell half.

lines.zh: 点心留下，你可以问一个问题。
lines.en: Leave the sweets and you may ask one question.

lines.zh: 茶叶不错，是南边来的。
lines.en: Good tea leaves. From the south, aren't they?

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，只贪一口甜的。
lines.en: At my age I only crave something sweet.

lines.zh: 你把东西放在球旁边，别碰它。
lines.en: Set it by the sphere. Don't touch the sphere.

lines.zh: 金币响的声音，我最爱听。
lines.en: The sound of gold coins is my favorite.

lines.zh: 你带的这些，不够问大事。
lines.en: What you brought won't buy a big question.

lines.zh: 拿吃的贿赂算命的，真新鲜。
lines.en: Bribing a fortune teller with food. New.

lines.zh: 我看看你的手相，再决定收不收。
lines.en: Let me read your palm, then I'll decide.

lines.zh: 这一份，算你半价。
lines.en: This one's half price, for you.

lines.zh: 小心，别撞翻我的茶。
lines.en: Careful. Don't spill my tea.

lines.zh: 你撞得水晶球晃了一下。
lines.en: That made the crystal wobble.

lines.zh: 我这身子骨经不起推。
lines.en: This old frame can't take a shove.

lines.zh: 退开些，你挡住我的光了。
lines.en: Move aside; you're blocking my light.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的托盘了。
lines.en: Your knee hit my tray.

lines.zh: 别踩我的裙摆，会摔的。
lines.en: Don't step on my hem; I'll fall.

lines.zh: 我飘得不快，你让一让就行。
lines.en: I don't drift fast. Just step aside.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的签筒都倒了。
lines.en: That knocked my fortune sticks over.

lines.zh: 你身上热气太重，离远点。
lines.en: You give off too much heat. Farther, please.

lines.zh: 我倒不了，这球接得住我。
lines.en: I won't fall; the sphere holds me.

lines.zh: 我这年纪，只谈茶和命。
lines.en: At my age, I speak only of tea and fate.

lines.zh: 你算错人了，孩子。
lines.en: You've got the wrong woman, child.

lines.zh: 水晶球里没有这一卦。
lines.en: The crystal holds no reading for that.

lines.zh: 先把手从桌上拿开。
lines.en: Take your hand off the table first.

lines.zh: 我这辈子，早就看透了。
lines.en: I saw through all of that long ago.

lines.zh: 茶凉了，说这些也没意思。
lines.en: The tea's cold, and so is this talk.

lines.zh: 你要问姻缘，得加钱。
lines.en: For a question of love, the price goes up.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢听别人的故事。
lines.en: I prefer hearing other people's stories.

lines.zh: 别把香炉碰倒，那更值钱。
lines.en: Don't knock the brazier; it's worth more.

lines.zh: 这种事，我算不出来。
lines.en: That's one thing I can't divine.

lines.zh: 一枚铜钱，正好补卦资。
lines.en: A copper coin — that covers the fee.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的签，重新插好。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen stick and set it back.

lines.zh: 这包茶叶，我收进袖里。
lines.en: This packet of tea goes up my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我拾起一颗珠子，对着光看。
lines.en: I pick up a bead and hold it to the light.

lines.zh: 地上有片碎瓷，我扫到一边。
lines.en: A shard of porcelain; I sweep it aside.

lines.zh: 谁掉的纸符？我看看写的什么。
lines.en: Whose paper charm is this? Let me read it.

lines.zh: 我捡起钱袋，掂了掂重量。
lines.en: I pick up the purse and weigh it.

lines.zh: 这块糕点还没脏，能吃。
lines.en: This cake isn't dirty. Still edible.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，你别催。
lines.en: I bend slowly. Don't hurry me.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的蜡烛，还能点。
lines.en: A dropped candle. Still lightable.

lines.zh: 你的影子不对，我盯上了。
lines.en: Your shadow's wrong. I've marked it.

lines.zh: 我不用站起来，也看得住你。
lines.en: I don't need to stand to keep you in sight.

lines.zh: 你别想从我的厅里拿走什么。
lines.en: You won't take anything from my hall.

lines.zh: 这一卦我算到了，你今晚会来。
lines.en: I read this: you'd come tonight.

lines.zh: 我看向门口，你就站在那里。
lines.en: I look to the door, and there you are.

lines.zh: 我的客人从不偷偷摸摸。
lines.en: My guests never skulk.

lines.zh: 水晶球变红了，说明有麻烦。
lines.en: The crystal's turned red. Trouble.

lines.zh: 你手上有杀气，藏不住的。
lines.en: There's killing intent on your hands. It shows.

lines.zh: 我不动手，我的客人会。
lines.en: I don't fight. My guests do.

lines.zh: 站住，把话说完再走。
lines.en: Stand there and finish what you were saying.

lines.zh: 你在门边站了很久了吧。
lines.en: You've lingered by that door a while.

lines.zh: 我眼睛不好，但心看得清。
lines.en: My eyes are weak; my mind isn't.

lines.zh: 你的心跳比刚才快了。
lines.en: Your heart's quicker than before.

lines.zh: 别绕到帘子后面，我看得见。
lines.en: Don't slip behind the curtain. I can see.

lines.zh: 我在等你自己说出实话。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to tell the truth yourself.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就知道你要做什么。
lines.en: You lift a hand, and I know what it means.

lines.zh: 茶还热着，你跑不远的。
lines.en: The tea's still hot. You won't get far.

lines.zh: 我把椅子转过来，正对着你。
lines.en: I turn my chair to face you square.

lines.zh: 你往左挪一步，我的目光跟着。
lines.en: You edge left; my gaze follows.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里，没有我看漏的角落。
lines.en: No corner of this room escapes me.

lines.zh: 我抬手一指，你就退了。
lines.en: I point, and you step back.

lines.zh: 我敲了敲水晶球，声音很响。
lines.en: I tap the crystal, and it rings out.

lines.zh: 我不打人，我的客人会打。
lines.en: I don't strike. My guests do.

lines.zh: 这一下是敲你的手背。
lines.en: That was a rap on your knuckles.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我就用扇子挡。
lines.en: You reach out; my fan blocks it.

lines.zh: 我推了你的胸口一把，很轻。
lines.en: I push your chest, lightly.

lines.zh: 别碰我的球，这是最后一次。
lines.en: Don't touch my sphere. That's the last warning.

lines.zh: 我的签筒砸在你脚边。
lines.en: My stick jar lands at your feet.

lines.zh: 我手劲不大，但打得很准。
lines.en: I'm not strong, but I aim true.

lines.zh: 我把茶泼出去，烫到你了。
lines.en: I fling the tea; it scalds you.

lines.zh: 灯笼亮了，我的厅开了门。
lines.en: The lanterns light; my hall opens.

lines.zh: 我在堂上坐好，等今天的客人。
lines.en: I settle in the hall to await today's guest.

lines.zh: 水晶球先亮，我才现身。
lines.en: The crystal glows first, then I appear.

lines.zh: 这栋房子是给我建的，我住下了。
lines.en: This house was built for me. I've moved in.

lines.zh: 我把帘子挂好，摆正椅子。
lines.en: I hang the curtain and straighten the chair.

lines.zh: 香点上，烟起来的这一刻我就到。
lines.en: I light the incense; when the smoke rises, I'm there.

lines.zh: 有人念了我的名字，我便来了。
lines.en: Someone spoke my name, so I came.

lines.zh: 我从别的世界过来，很累。
lines.en: I came from another world. I'm tired.

lines.zh: 茶煮好了，客人也该到了。
lines.en: The tea's ready, and the guest should be too.

lines.zh: 今天不算大卦，只见一个人。
lines.en: No grand readings today. Just one visitor.

lines.zh: 香炉的火星溅到我袖子上。
lines.en: A spark from the brazier caught my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从水晶球上滑下来，屁股着地。
lines.en: I slide off the sphere and land on my seat.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的茶盘，我抓着桌沿。
lines.en: Water floods my tray; I grip the table edge.

lines.zh: 爆炸把帘子掀飞，我的球滚了出去。
lines.en: The blast blows the curtain away and my sphere rolls off.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过帘子，钉在柱上。
lines.en: An arrow parts the curtain and sticks in the pillar.

lines.zh: 有股力在翻我的卦，我看不清了。
lines.en: A force shuffles my reading; I can't see it.

lines.zh: 一天没吃东西，手都在抖。
lines.en: A day without food and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷顺着屋檐下来，我耳朵嗡嗡的。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the eaves; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 地面没了，我的球也往下坠。
lines.en: The floor's gone, and my sphere falls with me.
